1.name: Qwen Image 2.1 TextImage2Image Turbo 7B (Current Default)
1.suitability_notes: Rank #1 (Current): Fast 8-step distilled 7B model with native 2K (1664x960) & 4-portrait <image1..4> support (~35s/image). Fast, though 8-step distillation (CFG=1.0) can occasionally simplify complex multi-person spatial prompts.

2.name: Qwen Image 2.1 TextImage2Image 7B (Full 40-Step Base Model)
2.suitability_notes: Rank #2 (Most Recommended Upgrade): Un-distilled 40-step base version of Qwen Image 2.1 with full Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG=4.0). Reuses your already-installed Qwen3-VL encoder & VAE; follows complex spatial/Venn layouts, eye/mouth rules, and facial likeness much more faithfully than #1 Turbo.

3.name: Flux 2 Klein 9B KV (4-Step Reference KV-Cached)
3.suitability_notes: Rank #3: 9B Flux 2 Klein model with dedicated Reference KV-Caching across denoising steps. Specifically engineered for multi-reference character consistency at high speed (4 steps).

4.name: Flux 2 Klein Base 9B (Full 30-Step Un-Distilled CFG=4.0)
4.suitability_notes: Rank #4: Full 30-step un-distilled 9B Flux 2 Klein with CFG=4.0. Stronger prompt adherence, anatomy, and multi-character separation than the 4-step distilled variants.

5.name: Flux 2 Klein 9B (4-Step Distilled Standard)
5.suitability_notes: Rank #5: Standard 4-step distilled 9B Flux 2 Klein using Qwen3-8B text encoder. Much stronger facial identity than the 4B Klein model while remaining very fast.

6.name: Flux 3 Image Klein Base 5.6B (Full 50-Step CFG=3.5)
6.suitability_notes: Rank #6: Latest Flux 3 architecture with Qwen3-VL-4B vision-language encoder and native ordered <ref_image_0..3> reference conditioning (50 steps, CFG=3.5).

7.name: Flux 3 Image Klein 5.6B (16-Step Distilled)
7.suitability_notes: Rank #7: 16-step distilled Flux 3 Klein 5.6B with Qwen3-VL-4B vision-language encoder and ordered <ref_image_0..3> reference conditioning.

8.name: SenseNova U1.5 8B MoT (50-Step Unified VLM + Diffusion)
8.suitability_notes: Rank #8: 8B Mixture-of-Transformers architecture combining VLM understanding and image generation. Excels at complex spatial positioning, object counts, and multi-reference scenes.

9.name: Qwen Image Edit Plus (2511) 20B (40-Step Multi-Subject)
9.suitability_notes: Rank #9: Large 20B Qwen2.5-VL model tuned in release 2511 for combining multiple person references at 1664x960 with high identity retention. Slower on 8GB VRAM due to 20B size.

10.name: Fibo 2.0 Dev (50-Step Multi-Reference CFG=5.0)
10.suitability_notes: Rank #10: 50-step Fibo 2.0 Dev using Qwen3-VL-4B encoder + Flux 2 VAE; supports up to 4 ordered reference images.

11.name: Fibo 2.0 Edit Turbo (4-Step Distilled Multi-Reference)
11.suitability_notes: Rank #11: Fast 4-step distilled variant of Fibo 2.0 supporting 4 ordered reference images.

12.name: Flux 2 Klein Base 4B (30-Step Un-Distilled CFG=4.0)
12.suitability_notes: Rank #12: 30-step un-distilled 4B Flux 2 Klein. Low VRAM footprint with better prompt adherence than the 4-step 4B model, though 7B/9B models hold faces better.

13.name: Flux 2 Klein 4B (4-Step Distilled — Already Installed)
13.suitability_notes: Rank #13: Already downloaded on disk. Very fast (~15s, 4 steps), good lighting/atmosphere, but 4B capacity can lose facial likeness in complex two-shots.

14.name: Flux 1 Kontext DreamOmni2 12B (25-Step Multimodal)
14.suitability_notes: Rank #14: 12B Flux 1 Kontext model trained with DreamOmni2 for multi-reference subject generation and instruction following.

15.name: pi-FLUX.2 Dev 32B (4-Step Distilled Giant Model)
15.suitability_notes: Rank #15: 4-step pi-Flow distilled 32B Flux 2 model. High capacity, but 32B requires heavy RAM-to-VRAM offloading on 8GB VRAM.

16.name: Flux 2 Dev 32B Base (30-Step Full Giant Model)
16.suitability_notes: Rank #16: Full 30-step 32B Flux 2 Dev model. Highest parameter count in Wan2GP, but very slow on 8GB VRAM due to 32B offloading.

1.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA Pruned PDD 8-Step 20B (Current Default)
1.suitability_notes: Rank #1 (Current Default — Already Installed): Fast 8-step PDD distilled 20B model (merges 32 intervals into 8 evaluations). Native <Picture 1> start-frame lock, vocal soundtrack lip-sync, and GVA grouped-row spatial mask inpainting.

2.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA PDD 8-Step 33B (Full Unpruned 8-Step PDD)
2.suitability_notes: Rank #2 (Top Recommended Upgrade): Full 33B unpruned counterpart to #1. Keeps fast 8-step PDD speed and identical GVA mask/lip-sync behavior while restoring the unpruned 33B AdaLN modulation weights for sharper faces, hands, and lip motion.

3.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA Pruned VDN 8-Step 20B (Hybrid Window/Linear Attention)
3.suitability_notes: Rank #3: Reuses your already-installed 20B Pruned FL2VA base with the VDN 8-step acceleration LoRA and trained hybrid window/linear attention for faster, smoother long clips.

4.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA VDN 8-Step 33B (Full 33B Hybrid Attention)
4.suitability_notes: Rank #4: Full 33B unpruned FL2VA with VDN 8-step acceleration LoRA and hybrid window/linear attention.

5.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA Pruned 20B (Full 20-Step Un-Distilled — Zero Download)
5.suitability_notes: Rank #5 (Zero-Download Quality Upgrade): Uses your already-installed 20B Pruned FL2VA weights without 8-step PDD merging, running 20 true Euler steps (flow_shift=7.0). ~2.5x slower than #1, but cleaner motion and lip-sync on difficult shots.

6.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA Pruned Veda Sparse 20B (20-Step Learned Sparse Attention)
6.suitability_notes: Rank #6: Reuses your 20B Pruned FL2VA weights with Veda learned sparse attention (up to 2x faster than #5 at 20 steps on RTX 30/40/50 GPUs).

7.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA 33B Base (Full 20-Step Unpruned Reference Quality)
7.suitability_notes: Rank #7: Full 33B unpruned, un-distilled MiniMax H3 FL2VA at 20 steps. Highest fidelity in the FL2VA family, though slowest per clip.

8.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA Veda Sparse 33B (20-Step Sparse 33B)
8.suitability_notes: Rank #8: Full 33B unpruned FL2VA with Veda learned sparse attention to accelerate 20-step high-fidelity generation.

9.name: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA Pruned PTD RefAsymOPD 8-Step 20B
9.suitability_notes: Rank #9: 8-step Ref2VA 20B with RefAsymOPD per-step hop LoRAs tuned for sharper facial details and more realistic backgrounds at 8 steps (uses audio_prompt_type=AS).

10.name: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA PTD RefAsymOPD 8-Step 33B
10.suitability_notes: Rank #10: Full 33B unpruned version of #9 with 8-step RefAsymOPD hop LoRAs for sharper details and realism.

11.name: MiniMax H3 FastH3 Omni 8-Step 20B (FastVideo VSA Student)
11.suitability_notes: Rank #11: FastVideo 8-step distilled Ref2VA student with VSA sparse attention (fastest H3 20B model).

12.name: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA Pruned PDD 8-Step 20B
12.suitability_notes: Rank #12: Ref2VA 20B counterpart to #1 using 8-step PDD interval merging.

13.name: MiniMax H3 Singularity V2 Ref2VA Pruned 20B (20-Step Fine-Tune)
13.suitability_notes: Rank #13: Singularity V2 20B fine-tune of MiniMax H3 Ref2VA (20 steps) for rich cinematic contrast and motion.

14.name: LTX-2 2.5 Distilled 22B (8-Step Audio-Video + IC-LoRA Inpainting)
14.suitability_notes: Rank #14: Different model family (Lightricks LTX-2.5 22B Distilled, 8 steps, Gemma-4 12B encoder). Supports start-image + audio lip-sync and uses LTX-2 Inpainting IC-LoRA (MVGA) for Pass 2 masked duets.

15.name: LTX-2 2.3 Distilled 1.1 22B (8-Step Audio-Video + IC-LoRA Inpainting)
15.suitability_notes: Rank #15: LTX-2.3 Distilled 1.1 22B checkpoint (8 steps) with start-image + soundtrack conditioning and IC-LoRA masked inpainting (MVGA).

16.name: LTX-2 2.5 Dev 22B (2-Phase Distilled-Ancestral Quality)
16.suitability_notes: Rank #16: Full LTX-2.5 Dev 22B running 2-phase generation with distilled_8_steps_ancestral for stronger prompt adherence and detail than #14.

anchors.prompt: A cinematic 16:9 medium close-up inside a dark recording soundstage. In the foreground stands {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} at a vintage brass condenser microphone, with his eyes clearly open and expressive, leaning slightly into the microphone as he sings. He stands inside a single large glowing sapphire-blue Venn circle of light on the wooden floor, and in soft bokeh behind him sit chamber orchestra string players (violinists and cellists) bowing their instruments.

A cinematic 16:9 medium waist-up shot inside a grand dark recording soundstage. {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} stands at a vintage brass stand microphone, gripping the mic stand with one hand, eyes clearly open, singing passionately. Around him on the wooden stage floor glows a single large all-encompassing sapphire-blue Venn circle of light where a chamber string orchestra (violins, violas, cellos, and a grand piano) is seated playing behind him, while on the far right edge three smaller overlapping warm golden-amber circles glow softly.

A single continuous, undivided wide-angle 16:9 photograph inside one open recording soundstage (no split-screen, no vertical divider line, continuous wooden floor and continuous dark studio wall across the entire frame). On the continuous wooden floor, a single large glowing sapphire-blue Venn circle on the left intersects with a cluster of three warm golden-amber Venn circles on the right. Standing on the left side inside the sapphire-blue floor circle is {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} at a vintage brass studio microphone in three-quarter profile facing right toward the woman, eyes clearly open, singing to her with two seated violinists in soft bokeh behind him. Standing in the same room on the right side inside the three overlapping golden-amber floor circles is {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} in three-quarter profile facing left toward him with her eyes open and her mouth completely closed, holding lyric sheets and chord charts by a music stand as she listens intently to his vocal take.

A single continuous, undivided 16:9 medium-wide photograph inside one open wood-paneled recording studio (no split-screen, no vertical divider, continuous studio room and continuous wooden floor across the entire frame). On the continuous wooden floor, one large glowing sapphire-blue circle on the left overlaps with three intersecting warm golden-amber Venn circles on the right. On the left side inside the sapphire-blue floor circle stands {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} at a vintage brass stand microphone turned in three-quarter profile facing right toward the woman, eyes clearly open, singing emotionally while gripping the mic stand. In the exact same room on the right side inside the three overlapping golden-amber Venn circles sits {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} on a studio stool beside a music stand with sheet music, headphones around her neck, and an acoustic-electric guitar on a stand beside her, her eyes open and her mouth completely closed as she watches him sing with a cellist seated in the background.

A high-angle cinematic 16:9 wide crane shot over a dark recording soundstage floor illuminated by a glowing Venn diagram of light rings: on the left is one single giant all-encompassing sapphire-blue circle of light containing a full chamber string orchestra (violins, violas, cellos, double bass) bowing in unison; on the right is a multi-set Venn diagram of three intersecting warm golden-amber and rose circles of light containing a pop drum kit, bass amp, and guitar stand; where the giant blue circle overlaps one of the golden circles in a glowing violet intersection at the center stand {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} (left, facing right, eyes open, mouth closed) and {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} (right, facing left, eyes open, mouth closed) looking at each other.

A cinematic 16:9 medium shot on the recording soundstage illuminated by three intersecting warm golden-amber Venn circles of light on the wooden floor. In the foreground center-right stands {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} with an electric pop guitar strapped over her shoulder, angled in three-quarter view with her eyes clearly open and her mouth completely closed, playing a melodic guitar intro while looking toward the left. In the background on the left inside a large sapphire-blue circle of light, {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} stands by his microphone with his mouth closed watching her play alongside seated string players.

A cinematic 16:9 medium two-shot at the center of the recording soundstage where a single large sapphire-blue floor circle (left) overlaps with three intersecting warm golden-amber floor circles (right) in a glowing violet Venn intersection. On the left half stands {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} at a vintage brass stand microphone in three-quarter profile facing right, eyes clearly open and mouth completely closed. On the right half stands {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} at her vintage brass stand microphone in three-quarter profile facing left, eyes clearly open and mouth completely closed, looking deeply into his eyes just before she begins to sing, with violinists and cellists seated in soft bokeh behind them.

A cinematic 16:9 medium two-shot inside the wood-paneled recording studio during a duet vocal recording. On the left half (`x < 50%`), illuminated by a single large sapphire-blue floor circle, stands {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} at a vintage brass condenser microphone, turned in three-quarter profile facing right toward the woman, eyes clearly open and locked on her eyes as he sings directly to her, with violinists seated in soft bokeh behind him. On the right half (`x > 50%`), illuminated by three overlapping warm golden-amber Venn floor circles, stands {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} at her vintage brass condenser microphone, turned in three-quarter profile facing left toward the man, eyes clearly open and locked on his eyes as she sings directly to him, with her guitar on a stand in the warm background.

A cinematic 16:9 medium-wide two-shot on the dark recording soundstage with glowing floor Venn diagram lighting: one giant sapphire-blue circle on the left overlapping with a cluster of three warm golden-amber circles on the right. On the left half (`x < 50%`) stands {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} at a vintage brass stand microphone in three-quarter profile facing right, eyes clearly open, singing passionately to her. On the right half (`x > 50%`) stands {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} at her vintage brass stand microphone in three-quarter profile facing left, eyes clearly open, singing passionately to him. In the background inside the glowing rings sit chamber string players bowing violins and cellos.

A cinematic 16:9 medium-wide shot inside the recording soundstage as the pop drum kit kicks in. In the foreground left (`x < 50%`) inside his large sapphire-blue floor circle stands {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} at a vintage brass stand microphone, eyes clearly open, singing with expressive energy. In the midground right (`x > 50%`) inside three overlapping warm golden-amber Venn circles on the floor, a pop drummer actively plays an acoustic drum kit with drumsticks in motion while {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} stands beside the drummer with her mouth closed and eyes open, nodding to the beat as the pop rhythm section joins the song.

A cinematic 16:9 medium shot inside an upscale atmospheric lounge at night with overhead Venn ring chandeliers (one single sapphire-blue ring on the left overlapping with three warm golden-amber rings on the right). Sitting side-by-side at the exact same curved leather booth table are {MALE_NIGHTOUT_DESC} (on the left half, `x < 46%`) and {FEMALE_NIGHTOUT_DESC} (in the center-right, `x = 48%..72%`), with two cheerful friends seated on the far right (`x > 72%`). Under the single cool sapphire-blue light on the left, the Black male lead feels emotionally isolated, turned in three-quarter profile toward the woman right beside him, eyes open and aching as he sings directly to her. Right next to him at the same table under the overlapping warm golden rings, the auburn-haired woman has her back/shoulder slightly to him, turned toward their friends on the right with her mouth closed in a bright laugh, clinking cocktail glasses and completely engrossed with her friends.

A cinematic 16:9 medium-wide shot on the recording soundstage at the musical climax where the electric bass guitar and rising violins enter together. In the foreground center-left inside his large sapphire-blue floor circle stands {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} gripping his vintage brass stand microphone, eyes clearly open, singing with intense emotion. Behind him on the left inside the blue circle, a section of violinists stands bowing rising string melodies; behind him on the right inside three overlapping warm golden-amber Venn floor circles, a bass guitarist plays an electric bass guitar alongside the drummer on the drum kit.

A cinematic 16:9 medium two-shot on the grand recording soundstage surrounded by both the chamber string orchestra and the pop rhythm section (drummer and bass guitarist). On the wooden floor, one giant sapphire-blue circle on the left overlaps with three intersecting warm golden-amber Venn circles on the right. On the left half (`x < 50%`) stands {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} at his vintage brass microphone in three-quarter profile facing right, eyes clearly open and locked on her eyes, singing directly to her. On the right half (`x > 50%`) stands {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} at her vintage brass microphone in three-quarter profile facing left, eyes clearly open and locked on his eyes, singing directly to him.

A cinematic 16:9 medium-wide two-shot on the grand recording soundstage at the end of the song. Standing central in the frame facing each other in three-quarter profile (with no microphones blocking their faces) are {MALE_STUDIO_DESC} on the left and {FEMALE_STUDIO_DESC} on the right. Both have their eyes clearly open looking tenderly into each other's eyes, and both have their mouths completely closed. On the wooden floor around them glows a clear Venn diagram: one single giant all-encompassing sapphire-blue circle around him on the left (containing the string orchestra) and a multi-circle Venn diagram of three intersecting warm golden-amber circles around her on the right (containing the drummer, bassist, and guitars), touching at a luminous violet tangent point between them.
